description: Mark a feature as complete. Only callable from the ship phase. For a managed build-mode feature (one with a feature.json) this goes through the completion gate (COMP-COMPLETION-GATE): the commit is verified and tests attested when capabilities.guard is on, ONE guarded transition is ledgered, and the gate writes the completion record, feature.status COMPLETE, ROADMAP.md and the cockpit item. A refusal (bad evidence, KILLED feature, guard refused) returns 422 and writes nothing. A commit is required in every git workspace, guard or not (COMP-DOGFOOD-LAND-1): name commit_sha, or branch (its tip is taken), or neither when exactly one local or origin/ branch ends with the feature code; no match is refused SHA_REQUIRED, several SHA_AMBIGUOUS, a commit_sha off the named branch SHA_NOT_ON_BRANCH, a sha receipt for another commit EVIDENCE_SHA_MISMATCH. The result carries sha_source (given, branch-tip, feature-branch). A workspace that is not a git repo keeps the commit-less path with a WARNING. Fix/plan items and items with no feature.json transition as before.

branch.description: Git branch the work landed from; its tip is the commit when commit_sha is omitted.

commit_sha.description: Commit SHA (7-40 hex). Must exist; with branch it must be that branch's tip or an ancestor. Omit to take it from branch, or from the one branch named after the feature code.

evidence.description: Receipt for the claim, re-checked by the server (contracts/evidence.schema.json): an object {kind, at (ISO time), by (session), ...kind fields} with kind sha {repo, sha, branch? (a land_branches name, e.g. "2.0")} | process {pid, launched_at, label, exit_file?, log?} (checked at launch + 120 s or later) | file {path, line?} | log {path, line} | screenshot {path, region?} | command {command, output_line, log} | pixel {path, point {x, y}, expected "#rrggbb"}; or an "ev:<id>" from `node lib/evidence-cli.js record`. Refused without one (EVIDENCE_REQUIRED) unless the workspace sets capabilities.evidence false. The accepted id comes back as evidence_id.

files_changed.description: Repo-relative paths committed in the SHA.

notes.description: One-line note for the completion record.

repo.description: Absolute path of the git repo holding the commit. Default: the git top level of the workspace root.

tests_pass.description: Defaults to true when commit_sha is provided.

name: complete_feature
